critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/pricing/calculate expects 'quantity' at payload root, not inside pricing_data. Frontend (PricingCalculator.js line 947) already sends it at root - consistent. Any future callers should follow same convention.
For unknown wrap_material_key or wrap_laminate_type_key, backend falls back to calendared/gloss and returns a warning in breakdown (wrap_material_warning/laminate_warning). Good defensive handling.
Frontend WRAP_MATERIAL_DEFAULTS and WRAP_LAMINATE_DEFAULTS keys match backend seeded keys (wrap_premium_cast, wrap_laminate_gloss, etc.) - no key mismatch bug.
PricingCalculator.js is now 3298 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting category-specific UI into separate components for maintainability.
